why: Only one major reviewer is in the results: Macworld, with a tested guide to Mac docks. It covers extended-mode limits only in part and is not written for the M4 Air. Plugable answers the question directly, but only with its own dock. Everything else is affiliate listicles or small sites working from specs, and none of them show current prices. A focused M4 Air page with priced, verified picks could get in, but it would be competing with Macworld and Plugable.
